name: Isolate a household water leak
short_description: Locate and close the appropriate accessible shutoff for a simulated household water leak.
self_assessment: I can isolate a simulated household water leak within two minutes without help.
description: Locate and close the appropriate accessible shutoff for a simulated household water leak. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Close a labelled fixture shutoff during a dry drill

builds_on.note: Assembly practice supports systematic identification of accessible shutoffs.

safety_note: Water can damage property and contact electricity; avoid standing water near power, close the accessible shutoff, and call qualified help for hidden faults.
